# @suluk/panel

> Contract-first admin panels, in the spirit of Payload but projected from one OpenAPI v4 document. Infers Payload-style field types from the contract, renders shadcn/theme-aware forms + data tables, and mounts a role-aware superadmin (and per-role dashboards) — no config DSL, no framework lock-in. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `fieldsOf`: Infer the ordered field set for an entity. `entities` is the set of entity names (for relationship detection).
- `titleField`: The entity's best "title" field — for list columns + relationship option labels.
- `humanize`: "coverImageUrl" → "Cover Image", "categoryId" → "Category".
- `entityModels`
- `renderInput`
- `renderFieldRow`: One labelled field row (label · required mark · description · the input).
- `renderList`
- `renderForm`
- `renderShell`
- `richtextEditor`: The editor markup for one rich-text field. `name` is the form field; `value` is the initial markdown.
- `richtextScript`: Client init for every `[data-rt]` on the page — toolbar inserts markdown around the selection; the Preview tab
 renders the markdown with an inline...
- `mediaEditor`
- `mediaScript`: Client init for every `[data-media]`: live preview on URL change + (if window.
- `panelApp`
- `PANEL_CSS`
- `RICHTEXT_CSS`
- `MEDIA_CSS`

## Optional

### Types

- `Field`: `@suluk/panel` — contract-first admin panels, in the spirit of Payload but projected from ONE OpenAPI v4 document.
- `FieldType`: Field-type inference — the Payload-parity core, contract-first.
- `EntityModel`
- `NavGroup`
- `NavItem`
- `StatCard`: A KPI tile on the dashboard home.
- `PanelSection`: A custom, non-CRUD page mounted at `${basePath}/s/<id>`, rendered inside the panel shell.
- `PanelGroup`: Sidebar grouping: a titled section listing entity names and/or section ids, in order.
